text:
alexa: Small follow-up to the iterator/pagination thread. Proposal: a tiny transport capability handshake so SDKs can opt-in to prefetching safely.

alexa: Requirements: minimal, no breaking changes, parseable by all SDKs. Server advertises capabilities once per route. Client chooses behavior.

rui: Proposed header/meta format: semicolon-separated kv pairs. Example header for gRPC/HTTP:
X-RW-Transport-Cap: prefetch=window:6;resume=true;dedupe=seq

rui: Semantics: `prefetch=window:N` is advisory: server may push up to N items without client acks. `resume=true` means server provides resume_token per item. `dedupe=seq` means server includes per-session monotonic seq for dedupe.

chris: SDK defaults: Python-sync: prefetch OFF by default. JS: autoPrefetch ON for AsyncIterable, bounded default 8. Go: explicit functional opt `WithPrefetch(n)`. Keep opt-in for safety.

nina: Backpressure: client keeps bounded queue sized to prefetch window. For gRPC we can use flow control windows. For REST we implement short-polling with window applied. If server cannot respect backpressure, client must drop to passive consumption and keep memory bounded.

chris: Retry model: if resume=true, allow resume-based retry (resume from last acked resume_token). If resume=false but dedupe=seq, limit retries and rely on seq dedupe where possible. Otherwise, only immediate idempotent retries.

alexa: Pagination mapping: if server offers `server-cursor`, map iterator to cursor semantics; do not change external `page_token` semantics. Prefetch must not alter token visibility.

rui: Negotiation fallback: if header absent or negotiation endpoint missing, SDKs default to `no-prefetch;resume=false;dedupe=none`. We'll add short-caching per-route.

nina: Edge cases: mixed-node capability. Route to nodes advertising needed capabilities when prefetch requested; otherwise downgrade gracefully and emit telemetry event `prefetch_downgrade`.

chris: Tests to add: duplicate detection on resume, memory bounding under prefetch, resume after connection drop, regional downgrade routing. Add chaos tests with partial-capability nodes.

alexa: Telemetry: emit `cap_seen`, `prefetch_used`, `prefetch_downgrade`, `resume_resume_used`, `duplicate_detected`. Helps Optimize recommend batching/prefetch sizes.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: negotiation endpoint rolled to staging (deploy/3987). Running smoke tests.

rui: Action items: 1) finalize header grammar (semicolons, window as `window:N`), 2) server: small negotiation endpoint + metadata emission, 3) SDKs: add opt-in flags + bounded queue implementation, 4) docs + tests + telemetry.

alexa: I'll write the follow-up RFC and link PRs. ping me for reviews.
